findings.quote: Here's a pricing mistake that costs East Bay landlords more than almost any repair: listing high to see what happens.
findings.root_cause: Neither the hypothetical rent-loss calculation nor the case record supports a comparative claim about almost all repair costs. Both scripts repeat it. The companion also generalizes a loss exceeding a year's premium outside the example.
findings.fix: Use 'Here's how testing a high rental price can cost thousands in lost rent.' Explicitly tie $3,450 and the year's-premium comparison to an assumed six extra vacant weeks in the hypothetical; label the Oct–Jan pricing instruction as professional opinion. Apply changes to both scripts and the companion summary.
findings.future_prevention: Do not convert a worked example into a market-wide quantitative claim; check script, takeaways and article together.
